One `asks!` list writes each method name and its parameter keys once, and generates `Ask::method()`. `Scoped` and `Batched` take an `Ask` and read its method, so the batch path uses the same types.
- `Rpc::call` takes a `Request` (parameters plus the method that reads them) in place of a `&'static str` and `impl Serialize`. The `json!` parameters of `initialize`, `parseConfigFile`, `createSnapshot`, `updateSnapshot`, `release` and `batchRequests` are now structs (`Changes`, `NewProgram`, `Reconfigured`, `FileNotifications` and so on), each implementing `Request`.
- `crates/semantic/src/declared.rs`: call sites only (`Asking::Symbol` with a method string becomes `Ask::DocumentationComment` and similar).

  - `every_key_sent_is_one_tsrs_reads`: a stand-in session records every request that each `Rpc` method sends, including the batches `declared` sends.
